Name: Futan Bear and Plush Bunny Retexture - Monokuma and Monomi
Author: taconeko99
Description:
[b][color=#ff0000][size=5]This mod uses an outdated format. Please install[/size][/color][size=5] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12262]Donirexian's[/url] [color=#ff0000]Content Patcher conversion of this mod instead.[/color][/size]


To install:[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Make backups of the furniture.xnb and Craftables.xnb files, in case you want to restore the defaults later.
[*]Replace furniture.xnb for Monokuma, and Craftables.xnb for Monomi.
[/list]
[b]Uninstalling:[/b]

[list=1]
[*]Delete furniture.xnb and Craftables.xnb, and restore your previous backups.
[/list]
This mod will overwrite other mods that edit either of the two files mentioned. However, I've provides the .png files so you can edit the spritesheets yourself to include any other custom edits you have.
